module_summary: MAC control frame receiver: byte-pointer header parser extracts dst/src/type/opcode/params from the passthrough AXIS stream, compares them with config fields, and emits matched frames on an MCF interface via a skid-buffered output.

anchors.name: read_mcf_reg
anchors.why: Two-state header-parse state: reading header bytes vs passing payload until tlast.

anchors.name: ptr_reg
anchors.why: Header byte cycle counter selecting which MCF field captures s_axis_tdata.

anchors.name: mcf_frame_reg
anchors.why: Frame-is-MAC-control flag recorded at opcode end; triggers mcf_valid and tuser marking.

anchors.name: mcf_match
anchors.why: Combined dst/src/type/opcode match against configuration, sets mcf_frame.

anchors.name: mcf_eth_dst_match
anchors.why: Destination MAC multicast/unicast match result feeding mcf_match.

anchors.name: mcf_opcode_match
anchors.why: LFC/PFC opcode match result feeding mcf_match.

anchors.name: mcf_eth_type_match
anchors.why: Ethertype compare against cfg_mcf_rx_eth_type.

anchors.name: mcf_valid
anchors.why: Pulse indicating a received MAC control frame with fields on mcf outputs.

anchors.name: mcf_opcode
anchors.why: Parsed control frame opcode output from mcf_opcode_reg.

anchors.name: mcf_params
anchors.why: Parsed control frame parameter bytes output from mcf_params_reg.

anchors.name: mcf_eth_dst
anchors.why: Parsed destination MAC output.

anchors.name: mcf_eth_src
anchors.why: Parsed source MAC output.

anchors.name: mcf_eth_type
anchors.why: Parsed ethertype output.

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input stream valid; advances parser and passes data through.

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input ready from registered output-side early ready.

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Input frame bytes parsed into header fields and passed to output.

anchors.name: s_axis_tlast
anchors.why: End of frame; finalizes MCF decision and resets parser.

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output stream valid from skid buffer output register.

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready controlling skid buffer transfers.

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output stream data from m_axis_tdata_reg.

anchors.name: m_axis_tuser_int
anchors.why: Output tuser forced bad for consumed control frames when not forwarding.

anchors.name: temp_m_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer temp storage when output is stalled.

anchors.name: m_axis_tready_int_reg
anchors.why: Registered internal ready deciding output vs temp register store.

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_output
anchors.why: Load enable moving internal data into output registers.

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_temp
anchors.why: Load enable capturing internal data into skid temp registers.

anchors.name: store_axis_temp_to_output
anchors.why: Selects temp registers as output register source.

anchors.name: cfg_mcf_rx_enable
anchors.why: Configuration enable gating MCF frame recognition.

anchors.name: cfg_mcf_rx_forward
anchors.why: Configuration choosing to forward or invalidate recognized control frames.

anchors.name: stat_rx_mcf
anchors.why: Statistics pulse for each received control frame.

groups.name: Header parser
groups.description: Pointer-driven header capture state and MCF frame flag.

groups.name: Match logic
groups.description: Compares parsed fields with config addresses, ethertype and opcodes.

groups.name: MCF output registers
groups.description: Captured header fields presented on the MCF interface.

groups.name: Output skid buffer
groups.description: Output and temp registers decoupling passthrough stream from m_axis ready.
